analysis.summary: Candidate RL-P02 brings relevant B2B procurement domain experience, search retrieval triage familiarity, and strong cross-functional stakeholder alignment. Key preparation gaps lie in defining systematic evaluation suites with hallucination release criteria, structuring rigorous causal measurement experiments, and designing pricing/cost models for AI-driven workflows.

top_gaps.why_now: The JD requires validating seat-based versus usage-based packaging while budgeting for the operational unit cost of failed or rejected model calls.
top_gaps.prep_action: Draft a unit-economics model comparing per-seat and per-document pricing structures against token costs, human-in-the-loop review overhead, and rejected inference waste.

top_gaps.why_now: The role must establish whether pilot results prove causal efficiency gains and lower clause omission rates relative to baseline reviews.
top_gaps.prep_action: Outline a paired or randomized A/B pilot methodology measuring task completion time, missed-clause error rates, and counterfactual baseline comparisons.

top_gaps.why_now: Setting objective release thresholds for unsupported warnings requires standardizing a multi-tier test set with clear error taxonomy.
top_gaps.prep_action: Develop an evaluation rubric specifying precision/recall expectations for contract clause extraction and clear criteria for flagging unsupported warnings.
